x: Eric, married to Mavis, daughter of past President of the Club, Tom Morrell, now lives in Cheshire. So great is his enthusiasm for Belgrave and competition that he still travels down regularly to compete, and he tells me, to chat over tactics and walking generally over a cup of tea in 'Joe Lyons's'…

Mavis, Hannah and Neil seem to have adapted to the way of life, which admittedly is more comfortable and relaxing. We have more time together as a family and, talking of families, we are expecting an increase in June!
John has now moved to Winnipeg and we wish him, Mavis and their children the best of luck in their new home. If anyone wishes to write to John his new address is [address withheld].
He was also a great help on the social scene and was a fine fellow who will be missed by all who knew him. Our deepest sympathy to his wife Mavis and family.
